title: Pilot's name
prompt: What name did the pilot give?
hint: Answer in one word. The pilot said, "This is Winky."

ja.hint: 1語で答えてください。パイロットは「This is Winky」と言いました。

title: Controller instruction
prompt: What did the controller tell the pilot to do?
hint: Use a short sentence (3–7 words). Follow the sample: "Proceed to the nearest runway."

ja.hint: 短い文で答えてください（3～7語）。例：「Proceed to the nearest runway.」
